meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 通过 lsp 工具调用语言服务器,能查文件或目录的诊断、跳转到定义、查找符号引用、查看文档/工作区符号,并在重命名前校验、执行重命名。
howto.when: 当需要语言服务器的诊断、定义、引用等能力,或要在当前工作区做重命名安全校验时触发。

say.text: 用 lsp.status 看下当前有哪些语言服务器
say.note: 列出已配置、已安装、缺失、启用的服务器

say.text: 检查 src/index.ts 的诊断,只看 error
say.note: 对该文件运行 diagnostics,按 error 过滤

say.text: 找出 foo 这个符号在整个工作区的引用
say.note: 在工作区范围内搜索该符号的使用处

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can call lsp MCP tools to talk to language servers: file or directory diagnostics, go-to-definition, symbol references, document and workspace symbols, plus rename validation and rename edits.
howto.when_en: Triggers when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

say_en.text: Use lsp.status to show which language servers are available
say_en.note: Lists configured, installed, missing, active servers

say_en.text: Check diagnostics for src/index.ts, errors only
say_en.note: Runs diagnostics on that file, filtered to errors

say_en.text: Find all workspace references to the symbol foo
say_en.note: Searches the workspace for uses of that symbol
